cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I Know the Procedure
cards.instruction: Perform investigative confidence while quietly using each response to discover what the questions, clues, and next steps should be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoulder against the door like you. Pressure test. As building manager, I'll establish why it won't lock.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was holding it open for you. The hinge is loose; I usually tighten it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Access checked. Show me your usual method so I can assess it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll need the screwdriver from your desk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, we've reached the tool stage. Which drawer do you normally find it in?

reason: Use copied door-holding as mistaken diagnostic test, then obtain repair sequence and tool location from B under performed managerial confidence.
